{"consolidated_memory":"LEAKED FIELD IN REDACTOR — platform/logging/redact.go

Recurring issue in the same corner of platform/logging/redact.go where a field that should be masked appears in log output. All reproductions use: log the nested payload fixture. Signal: unmasked value in log line.

EIGHT SEPARATE INCIDENTS:

INCIDENT 1 [2026-02-13, c017-e0]:
- Trigger: users in negative UTC offset only
- Root cause: unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: capped attempts, added exponential backoff with jitter (PR #1842, branch fix/leaked-field-1)
- Result: memory settled at 460 MB instead of climbing past 5 GB

INCIDENT 2 [2026-03-18, c017-e1]:
- Trigger: first request after cold start only
- Root cause: error swallowed by bare except
- Fix: narrowed handler, let failure propagate (PR #2833, branch fix/leaked-field-2)
- Result: 83 duplicate rows per day stopped being written

INCIDENT 3 [2026-03-20, c017-e2]:
- Trigger: traffic through corporate proxy only
- Root cause: clock skew between two hosts
- Fix: switched deadline to monotonic clock (PR #3119, branch fix/leaked-field-3)
- Result: reclaimed 92 GB of blob storage

INCIDENT 4 [2026-05-29, c017-e3]:
- Trigger: staging read replica only
- Root cause: schema drift between migration and model
- Fix: regenerated model from migration, pinned checksum (PR #4994, branch fix/leaked-field-4)
- Result: p99 latency fell from 8.3 s to 751 ms

INCIDENT 5 [2026-06-07, c017-e4]:
- Trigger: records with non-ASCII names only
- Root cause: serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- Fix: switched to strict schema rejecting unknown fields (PR #5896, branch fix/leaked-field-5)
- Result: job finished in 17 minutes instead of 7 hours

INCIDENT 6 [2026-07-30, c017-e5]:
- Trigger: empty input list only
- Root cause: cache entry never invalidated on write
- Fix: invalidated entry inside write transaction (PR #6897, branch fix/leaked-field-6)
- Result: error rate dropped from 3.0% to under 6 per 10,000

INCIDENT 7 [2026-08-05, c017-e6]:
- Trigger: tenants with more than 10,000 distinct keys only
- Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind lazy relation
- Fix: prefetched relation in single query (PR #8584, branch fix/leaked-field-7)
- Result: flaky test went from 94 failures per 100 runs to zero

INCIDENT 8 [2026-08-10, c017-e7]:
- Trigger: after client had already retried once only
- Root cause: missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Fix: normalised to NFC ahead of digest (PR #9003, branch fix/leaked-field-8)
- Result: cold start dropped 19%, to 766 ms

Pattern: Eight separate edge cases in the same code region, each with distinct trigger condition and root cause. Platform side work throughout."}
